pulse-counter.name: GPIO + cycle counter
pulse-counter.description: Rotate GPIO while counting active CPU clocks. Registers: GPIO, period, elapsed clocks, enable. SystemC SC_METHOD example.

timer.name: Clocked timer
timer.description: One-shot or periodic timer with a sticky compare flag. Registers: control (enable/periodic), period, elapsed, status (write one to clear). SystemC SC_METHOD example.

mailbox.name: Clocked mailbox FIFO
mailbox.description: Transmit a word; the next rising edge places it in an eight-word receive FIFO. Registers: TX, RX, status, control. Reading RX pops; inspection never pops. SystemC SC_METHOD example.
